$comment: Fixture items for .github/scripts/test-part-render.mjs (add-pc-sheet-v3 task 6.1/6.2).
ONE catalogue, put on EVERY structure's fixture actor, on purpose. The PC sheet is one
template set switched by settings.splat / settings.variantsheet / the has* flags, so an item a
splat cannot show is simply not shown -- and giving every structure the full catalogue is what
makes the matrix mean something: it exercises every block on every splat instead of only the
blocks that splat's 'realistic' character happens to fill. D9c says to cover the six splats with
no live actor at all for exactly that reason.
THIS FILE IS AUTHORED, AND THE HARNESS REFUSES TO TRUST IT. Two derived cross-checks run over it
on every invocation and both are hard failures:
1. every `wod.types.*` literal that appears in module/actor/template/pc-actor-sheet.js -- i.e.
every sub-kind one of the nine preparers actually asks for -- must have an entry here.
Adding a predicate to a preparer without a fixture for it therefore goes red rather than
silently rendering an empty block forever.
2. every power-section id in assets/data/sheet/powertab.js (primary + defaultOrder) must have
an entry whose `section` names it.
`system` is a SPARSE overlay. The full default document is derived at run time from the item's
DataModel (Ability/Advantage/Sphere/Realm/Splat) or from template.json's template composition
(everything else), so nothing here restates a schema and a schema change cannot rot it.
Field meanings:
key      unique, used in failure messages and in the `parent` back-reference
type     the Foundry Item document type
section  optional: the powertab.js section id this item is meant to fill
parent   optional: `key` of another entry; its generated _id is written to system.parentid
why      what would stop being covered if this entry were deleted
